builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Yuumi: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (2,981 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 59.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: An attached protector who follows an ally, manages Best Friend bonuses and combines guided poke with shield, attack-speed support and healing waves. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Mikael's Blessing → Ardent Censer → Moonstone Renewer. Summon Aery keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Dream Maker, Redemption.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Mikael's Blessing → Ardent Censer → Moonstone Renewer, with Summon Aery.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Mikael's Blessing → Ardent Censer → Moonstone Renewer) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 59.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Mikael's Blessing → Ardent Censer → Moonstone Renewer.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Yuumi summons an errant missile that deals [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 / 235 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy and Slows the target for [20]%.

If cast while Attached, Yuumi can control the missile using her mouse for a short period before it accelerates in a straight line. The accelerated missile deals [80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 / 355 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage and Slows the target for [50 / 53 / 56 / 59 / 62 / 65]% for [2] seconds, instead.

Best Friend Bonus: Prowling Projectile's Slow will always be enhanced and hitting an enemy champion also grants them [(0.05) × AP + 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20] magic damage On-Hit %i:OnHit% for [5] seconds.

The bonus On-Hit damage can be increased by [75]% based her ally's Critical Strike Chance.

Passive: While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional [(0.04 / 0.05 / 0.06 / 0.07 / 0.08) × 100]% Heal & Shield Power and her ally also restores [3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 + (0.03) × AP] health On-Hit %i:OnHit%.

Active: Yuumi dashes to an ally champion and Attaches to them. While Yuumi is Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is Untargetable except from towers.

Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this Ability on a [5] second Cooldown.

When Yuumi's Attacks and Abilities strike champions, she heals herself for [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 110; raw flags preserved) + (0.3) × AP] health. If Yuumi Attaches to an ally within [4] seconds, they are healed as well. This effect has a [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=-1, changes=[{"mLevel": 14, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown.

While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Friend and grants Yuumi bonus effects to her Abilities while she is Attached to them. 

The heal will automatically trigger if Yuumi is already Attached to an ally.

Yuumi channels for [3.5] seconds, launching [5] magical waves affecting both teams. If initially cast while Attached, Yuumi can steer the waves to follow her mouse.

Enemies struck are dealt [75 / 125 / 175 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage and Slowed by [10]% for [1.25] seconds, increased by [10]% per wave hit.

Ally champions are healed for [30 / 50 / 70 + (0.12) × AP] health per wave. Excess healing is converted to a Shield instead.

Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.12) × AP) × (UNRESOLVED({f3cbe7b2}; see calculationRaw))] health.

Casting You and Me! will locks the waves in the current direction.
Yuumi can move and cast Zoomies while channeling.

Yuumi shields herself, blocking [65 / 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 + (0.4) × AP] damage and gains [25 / 27.5 / 30 / 32.5 / 35 + (0.08) × AP]% Attack Speed for [3] seconds. While the shield persists, the target also gains [20]% Move Speed.

If Yuumi is Attached, this Ability affects her ally instead and also restores [20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36] Mana to them, increased by up to [100]% based on the target's missing Mana.

builds.name: Best-friend AP attack grant
builds.summary: Explore AP spending for the ally on-hit grant while retaining an eligible heal/shield buff.
builds.goal: Explore AP spending for the ally on-hit grant while retaining an eligible heal/shield buff.
builds.hypothesis: Best Friend Q grants five seconds of 0.05 AP on-hit damage, enhanced by the ally crit chance, and W grants 0.03 AP healing per ally hit. E supplies AP-scaled attack speed/shield; Ardent adds its own ally attack buff when E shields. Deathcap/Staff test AP investment versus ordinary support power, retaining the quest.
testPlan: Required state: Actual Best Friend with recorded attack rate and crit chance; land Q and shield before the attack window.
Count ally Q-granted on-hit and W healing packets over five seconds at fixed ally crit/attack rate.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A non-Best-Friend attachment or missed Q removes the on-hit grant and expensive AP fails to pay.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Buying crit on Yuumi does not supply the ally crit chance used by Q.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Rabadon's Deathcap, Dawncore, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Tempo and pursuit
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Yuumi: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: An attached protector who follows an ally, manages Best Friend bonuses and combines guided poke with shield, attack-speed support and healing waves. Fix attached ally and Best Friend state. Evaluate ally damage/survival and guided Q hits; offensive AP cannot erase attachment targeting and role-income constraints. Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
builds.summary: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
testPlan: Kit question for Yuumi: Fix attached ally and Best Friend state. Evaluate ally damage/survival and guided Q hits; offensive AP cannot erase attachment targeting and role-income constraints.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.

While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.

The route fails Yuumi's stated kit question: Fix attached ally and Best Friend state. Evaluate ally damage/survival and guided Q hits; offensive AP cannot erase attachment targeting and role-income constraints.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Imperial Mandate, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Chapter shield relay
builds.summary: Stagger E during the five R waves to keep attack-speed and ally protection useful.
builds.goal: Stagger E during the five R waves to keep attack-speed and ally protection useful.
builds.hypothesis: R launches five healing waves over 3.5 seconds and excess healing becomes shields; E can be cast during channel, adds shield/attack speed and restores missing-mana-scaled mana while attached. Moonstone can chain eligible ally heals/shields and Helia asks whether Q/R damage charges are consumed by these wave heals. Mikael can remove eligible control so the carrier moves the channel.
testPlan: Required state: Attached to an ally, R aimed at actual allies/enemies and E timed against incoming damage.
Log five wave heals/shields, Moonstone chains, Helia charge consumption and E mana restoration.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attaching mid-channel locks direction; healing full targets may create shields that expire unused.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Mikael does not remove airborne or suppression, and each wave is not free stored Helia charges.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
